objective: Deliver C-21 - the worker contract (class, limits, tier) owned by execution.scheduler - and the canonical admission decision built on it, in three atomic packages. Package 1: the declaration half, with the seven canonical worker classes and the six declaration dimensions parsed from EXECUTION_AND_CAPABILITY.md section 4 at call time rather than transcribed, validated under an injected PEP. Package 2: the admission decision, which admits only when ALL THREE section 4 conditions hold - the capability resolves other than NOT_CONFIGURED, an isolation composition satisfies the declared tier, and resource budget is available. Package 3: this composed integration and its evidence. C-21 is INT, so Phase 8 delivers no table, no migration and no state machine, and it delivers no allocation: admission decides whether work MAY run and starts nothing.

limitations: PRODUCTION ADMISSION CANNOT SUCCEED AND DOES NOT PRETEND TO. The Capability Graph is schema-only until Phase 9B, so condition (a) cannot hold and every production request is refused CAPABILITY_NOT_CONFIGURED. This is designed behaviour stated by EXECUTION_AND_CAPABILITY.md section 1, not a gap this phase could close. The ADMITTED branch is verified only through a test-only resolver implementing the same question. ARK-REQ-0354 (failure domains isolated; one failure does not crash unrelated capabilities) is assigned to PHASE 31 and is NOT CLAIMED by any Phase 8 evidence; the T12 chaos corpus is Phase 31 and ARK-REQ-0327 is not claimed. Phase 8 implements no allocation, dispatch, queue, priority, fairness, autoscaling, worker execution, provider runtime, durable-job interaction or persistence, and asserts each absence rather than assuming it. The resource condition evaluates a caller-supplied availability snapshot; who counts in-flight work is not Phase 8's authority. The canonical predicate for condition (a) is implemented exactly as section 4 words it - resolves other than NOT_CONFIGURED - and deliberately NOT narrowed to PASS, because post-activation resolution semantics belong to Phase 9B. This repository still has NO Python lockfile; the canonical environment is Python 3.13.15 with backend/pyproject.toml installed editable+dev.
